entities.name: Celtic Tiger & Contemporary Ireland

entities.summary: The Celtic Tiger economic boom (1994–2007), EU-funded modernisation, the 2008 financial crash and bailout, social transformation (marriage equality referendum 2015, abortion referendum 2018), Brexit's impact on the border, and Ireland as a global tech hub.
